hero.summary: Arithmetic coverage has expanded, but recognition and independent recall are still developing. The priority is translating disguised GMAT wording into the correct number-property structure.

bottleneck.title: Recognition / recall still developing
bottleneck.summary: Many rules make sense immediately after review, but independent retrieval becomes harder when the wording changes. This is different from not understanding the concept: train recognition, recall, and constraint interpretation before calculation.
drill: Before solving, ask: What mathematical structure is this wording secretly describing?
Translate equal groups → factors/GCF; first time together → LCM; left over → remainder; integer dimensions → factor pairs.
Retrieve the rule without notes, then move immediately to a disguised GMAT-style application.
Classify misses as recall, constraint, formula recognition, calculation, sign, endpoint, remainder setup, or divisibility reasoning.

recommendations.title: Finish exponent and root rules
recommendations.detail: Complete division, power-of-a-power, zero exponents and root/absolute-value links, then apply them without topic labels.

recommendations.title: Harder divisibility and remainder patterns
recommendations.detail: Translate divisibility constraints and n = dk + r before calculating; include transformed expressions and must-be-true questions.

recommendations.title: Disguised GCF / LCM applications
recommendations.detail: Practice equal grouping, synchronized cycles and smallest-common-multiple wording rather than obvious one-step drills.

recommendations.title: Prime factors and perfect powers
recommendations.detail: Combine exponent-count factors with perfect-square and perfect-cube conditions inside GMAT-style questions.

recommendations.title: Mixed number-properties reasoning
recommendations.detail: Use must-be-true / could-be-true sets covering parity, signs, consecutive integers, units digits and factor pairs.

recommendations.title: Absolute value and inequalities
recommendations.detail: Move from the basic two-case and endpoint rules into mixed medium questions and Data Sufficiency.

recommendations.title: Untitled medium-hard arithmetic sets
recommendations.detail: Do not reveal the topic. Ask what structure the wording secretly describes, then solve and classify any error.

recommendations.title: Timed mixed sets
recommendations.detail: Begin timing only after rule retrieval is reliable; recycle percentages, ratios, rates, weighted averages and proportionality.
